caption: The drawing depicts a large, detailed bird, specifically an eagle, occupying the center of the composition. The eagle is shown with its wings slightly spread and its talons visible, gripping a perch below. The feathers are individually delineated with precision, varying in shades of brown, tan, muted yellow, and hints of green; the areas around the head and neck feature darker and reddish tones. The beak is thick and curved, rendered in a darker brown color compared to the surrounding feathers. The background is a plain, light beige color, with no additional objects or features present, allowing the eagle to be the sole focus of the drawing. The overall composition captures the eagle from a frontal viewpoint, with both wings, body, head, and talons visible.
title: Finial Eagle
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
